meta.title: About Rent With Heldy | Local South Florida Car Rental
meta.description: Meet Rent With Heldy, a family-owned South Florida car rental company focused on hospitality, flexible vehicle delivery and personal service.

hero.title: Car Rental With a Little More Hospitality.
hero.intro: Rent With Heldy is a family-owned South Florida car rental company built around one idea: getting around should be the easiest part of your trip.
hero.imageAlt: A rental SUV waiting under a hotel entrance at sunset in South Florida

philosophy.quote: Customers are guests, not reservation numbers.
philosophy.body: That idea shapes everything we do. You deal with a local family, not a call center. Your questions get real answers, your plans can change, and the car comes to you.

story.heading: We bring the car to you.
story.p1: We run Rent With Heldy the way we would want to be looked after on a trip of our own. No rental counter, no long line, no hard sell. Just the right car, where and when you need it.
story.p2: We coordinate delivery to the airport, to hotels across Broward and Miami-Dade, and to the cruise ports at Port Everglades and PortMiami. When something changes, like a delayed flight or a longer stay, you message a real person who can help.

airport.title: Airport delivery
airport.body: We coordinate the easiest pickup at the airport, so you can skip the rental counter and the shuttle bus.

hotel.title: Hotel delivery
hotel.body: Staying in Fort Lauderdale or Miami? We can bring the car to your hotel.

cruise.title: Cruise port delivery
cruise.body: Starting or ending a cruise? We coordinate pickup at Port Everglades and PortMiami.

contactless.title: Contactless pickup
contactless.body: Contactless pickup is available on every rental, so you can get moving on your own schedule.

direct.title: Direct communication
direct.body: Call or text the family that runs the business. Plans change, and we are flexible.

local.title: Local knowledge
local.body: We live here. Ask us about parking, tolls, traffic or the easiest way to the beach.

miamiDade.title: Miami-Dade County
miamiDade.description: Miami Beach, Downtown Miami, Coral Gables, Aventura, and surrounding areas

broward.title: Broward County
broward.description: Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood, Pompano Beach, Davie, and surrounding areas

blog.eyebrow: From the Rent With Heldy Blog
blog.heading: More Than Just the Keys

finalCta.heading: Your car, where you need it.

meta.title: Privacy Policy | Rent With Heldy
meta.description: How Rent With Heldy collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you book a car rental in Fort Lauderdale, Miami, or South Florida.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: Rent With Heldy ("we", "us") respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect when you visit rentwithheldy.com or book a vehicle with us, how we use it, and the choices you have.

booking.desc: name, email, phone, and trip dates submitted through our booking widget.

verification.desc: required by our booking platform (driver's license, payment method) to complete a reservation.

account.desc: email, name, phone, language preference, and marketing choice you provide if you create an optional account, including when you sign in with Google.

communication.desc: messages, calls, and texts you send us about your reservation.

siteUsage.desc: basic analytics like pages visited and device type, used to improve the site.

use.heading: How we use your information
items: To process and manage your rental reservation.
To coordinate pickup, return, and support during your trip.
To respond to questions and provide customer service.
To improve the website and our service quality.
To comply with legal and tax obligations.

sharing.heading: Sharing of information
sharing.body: We do not sell your personal information. We share information only with the booking and payment platforms required to complete your reservation — reservations and payments are processed by Wheelbase, an Outdoorsy company, under its own terms and privacy policy, which you should review at checkout — and with service providers strictly as needed to operate the rental (for example, insurance verification).

accounts.heading: Accounts and Google sign-in
accounts.body: Creating an account is optional and is never required to book a vehicle. If you sign in with Google, Google shares only your name and email address with us; we never see or store your Google password. You can view and update your account details on your account page at any time, and you can ask us to delete your account and its data by emailing us.

cookies.heading: Cookies and analytics
cookies.body: We use minimal cookies for site functionality and aggregated analytics. You can control cookies through your browser settings.

choices.heading: Your choices
choices.text: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information by contacting us at

rights.heading: Your data rights
rights.intro: Wherever you are located, we honor the following requests about your personal information:
items: Access — receive a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
Correction — have inaccurate or incomplete information corrected.
Deletion — have your account and personal information deleted, except records we must keep for legal, tax, or safety reasons.
Portability — receive the information you provided to us in a commonly used format.
Objection and restriction — object to or limit certain processing, including opting out of marketing messages at any time.
rights.gdprNote: If you are visiting from the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, these rights are provided under the GDPR / UK GDPR, and you also have the right to lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority. We respond to all verified requests within the timelines required by applicable law.

meta.title: Terms of Service | Rent With Heldy
meta.description: Terms governing reservations, rentals, and use of the Rent With Heldy website and car rental service in Fort Lauderdale, Miami, and South Florida.

acceptance.heading: Acceptance of terms
acceptance.body: By accessing rentwithheldy.com or booking a vehicle with Rent With Heldy, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the site or book a vehicle.

reservations.heading: Reservations
reservations.body: Reservations are made through our booking platform, Wheelbase (an Outdoorsy company). The terms, cancellation policies, insurance requirements, and protection plans of that platform apply to every booking in addition to these terms. You are responsible for reviewing them at checkout.

accounts.heading: Accounts
accounts.body: You may create an optional account (with an email and password, or by signing in with Google) to save your details. You agree to provide accurate information, keep your credentials confidential, and notify us of any unauthorized use of your account. You are responsible for activity under your account. We may suspend or close an account used in violation of these terms, and you may delete your account at any time by contacting us.

eligibility.heading: Driver eligibility
items: Renters must be at least 21 (some vehicles require 25+).
A valid driver's license is required at pickup.
Only authorized drivers listed on the reservation may operate the vehicle.
The vehicle may not be used for illegal activity, racing, or off-road driving.

vehicleUse.heading: Vehicle use and condition
vehicleUse.body: You agree to return the vehicle in the same condition as received, normal wear excepted. Damage, excessive cleaning needs, unauthorized smoking, or pet hair beyond reasonable use may incur fees per the booking platform's policies.

cancellations.heading: Cancellations and changes
cancellations.body: Cancellation and change policies are governed by the booking platform you reserved through. We do our best to accommodate reasonable changes — message us as early as possible.

liability.heading: Liability
liability.body: Rent With Heldy is not liable for personal items left in the vehicle, third-party traffic violations, tolls, or charges incurred during your rental. Insurance and protection plans are handled through the booking platform.

website.heading: Website use
website.body: The content on this site is provided for informational purposes. We may update vehicles, pricing, and availability at any time. Live booking availability and pricing in the booking widget takes precedence over any information shown elsewhere on the site.

governingLaw.heading: Governing law
governingLaw.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.text: Questions about these terms? Reach us at

englishNotice.body: The following legal information is provided in English to preserve its original legal meaning. If you need assistance understanding any part of it, our team will be happy to help.
